build_preprocess_conditional_detr_images: build image preprocessing pipeline for Conditional DETR with COCO annotations, resizing, padding, and normalization
run_post_process_object_detection: run post-processing on Conditional DETR outputs to extract final bounding boxes with scores and labels
run_post_process_instance_segmentation: run instance segmentation post-processing on Conditional DETR outputs to get masks, segment IDs, and class predictions
run_post_process_panoptic_segmentation: run panoptic segmentation post-processing on Conditional DETR outputs with label fusion for semantic classes like sky
run_post_process_semantic_segmentation: run semantic segmentation post-processing on Conditional DETR outputs to produce per-pixel class prediction maps
